name: Crunch Time
summary:
Welcome to the clinic! In **Crunch Time**, you step into the shoes of an unlicensed chiropractor tasked with curing patients suffering from extreme, procedurally generated bad posture. 

Inspired by slapstick classics like *Surgeon Simulator*, this chaotic physics-based VR simulator lets you aggressively twist, pull, and pound your patients back into shape or accidentally make them much worse!

**🦴 CHAOTIC VR CHIROPRACTIC**
